input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant in § 2(a) runs to Client alone: neither affiliates nor contractors acting on our behalf are named, and there is no notice mechanic to add them, so the clause fails even the fallback (affiliates covered on written notice). Transfer is also constrained — § 15 permits assignment without consent only to a financially responsible affiliate, so a successor in an M&A transaction would require TrueLink's approval, again short of the fallback. The licence is not walk-away territory: it is not revocable at TrueLink's discretion and § 2(c) runs until the Agreement is terminated under the termination provisions. Minimal redline adds affiliate/contractor scope to the grant and successor transfer to § 15.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client, its affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, a non-exclusive license to use the Interface

ops.oldText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in interest in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, since our group and outsourced providers operate the origination process, and we added successor transfer so the licence survives a merger or sale. This matches our playbook position on licence scope and transaction continuity.
proposal.summary: Extend licence to Client's affiliates and contractors and permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction
